descriptions.zh:
我们从[From.Planet.GetName]的挖掘地点发回来的初步报告十分令人振奋，但又有点瘆人。

我们对撞击坑和其周边的地表残骸进行了分析，结果出人意料；显然那个未知物体在撞击发生的时候，既没有减速，也没有损坏。那个物体不知以什么方式击穿了泥土层，现在正停在地底深处。

我们随时可以进行进一步挖掘。
descriptions.en:
Initial reports from our excavation on [From.Planet.GetName] are both extraordinary and a bit unnerving.

Analysis of the surface debris in the impact crater and its immediate surrounding revealed a surprise; apparently the unknown object did neither break, nor brake, upon impact. Somehow the object managed to pierce through the soil, and is now resting deep in the ground.

Further excavations is ready to begin.

options.script:
name = DIG
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
随着在[From.Planet.GetName]上的发掘工作不断接近那个深藏在地下的物体，我们的科学家开始体验到了奇怪的现象。一眨眼间数个小时的时光便已流逝，崭新的设备突然就因磨损而报废，许多区域突然遍布残骸却没人知道怎么回事，如此等等。

科学团体对此无法做出确定的解释，但有一种理论声称撞击的物体由于穿透的星球的表层，因此便留下了能够扭曲时间的残留物。
descriptions.en:
As the excavation project on [From.Planet.GetName] got closer to the object resting deep in the ground, our scientists started to experience strange phenomena. Hours were lost in the blink of an eye, new equipment suddenly breaking due to wear and tear, areas cleared of debris and no one remembers how, and so on.

The scientific community can offer no real explanation, but one theory is that the crashed object left some kind of temporal-altering residue as it impaled the planet's crust.

options.script:
name = DIG
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们的发掘小组最后终于抵达了坠落在[From.Planet.GetName]上未知物体最后停下的位置。

结果我们发现，这个东西看上去没什么大不了的，和一个华丽的炮弹没什么区别。不过随后其所处的空间就震撼了我们的科学家们。

这里是一个巨大的穴室，除了最开始这个物体降临而在天花板上撞破的一个洞之外，整个穴室没有一处出入口，是完全密封的。穴室的墙壁由一层半透明的奇怪镀层覆盖，我们的科学家现在迫切想要对其进行进一步的调查。
descriptions.en:
Our excavation team finally reached the final resting place for the unknown object that crashed on [From.Planet.GetName].

As it turned out, the object was of minor interest - being little more than a glorified cannonball - but the location quickly astonished the scientists.

It was a huge chamber, hermetically sealed with no entry points other than the smashed hole in the ceiling where the object had come down. The walls were covered with strange, translucent plates that our scientists are now eager to scrutinize further.

descriptions.zh:
覆盖在位于[From.Planet.GetName]神秘穴室墙壁上的半透明镀层似乎毫无意义，直到一位队员用手轻轻触碰了一下。

整个穴室迅速被全息投影生成文字的光芒填充，发光的符号一行接一行地悬浮在半空。这些符号被迅速翻译后，穴室中镀层的意义终于显现出来，这是一个外星构件的详细蓝图。

一个也许能打开星门的外星构件。
descriptions.en:
The translucent plates covering the walls of the mysterious chamber found on [From.Planet.GetName] made little sense until one team member reached out and gently touched one:

The room exploded in light as holographic glyphs appeared out of nowhere - row after row of glowing symbols hovering in mid-air. The symbols were deftly translated and purpose of the plates in the chamber became clear: they contained detailed blueprints of an alien construction.

A construction that would open the gateway.

descriptions.zh:
在毫无征兆的情况下，位于我们母星系的神秘外星星门突然间被激活了！一道能量震荡从这座古迹中激射出来，一息之后，一个耀眼的、不断振动的球体填满了这个结构的重心。看来这个先行者文明的遗迹不再如同我们坚信的那样处于休眠状态了。

尽管星门仅仅打开了不过几秒钟，仍然有不少太空残骸从中穿过；经过细致的检查之后，其中的星岩与星尘成为了非常宝贵的资源。
descriptions.en:
Without slightest warning the mysterious alien gateway in our home system came alive! An energy surge pulsed out from the artifact, and for a fleeting moment a glowing, vibrating orb filled the center of the structure. This remnant of a former civilization may not be so dormant as previously believed.

Although the gateway was open for no longer than a few seconds, it was enough to let through some space debris; rocks and dust that upon closer inspection turned out to be valuable resources.

descriptions.zh:
再一次，沉睡的星门突然间激活了！不过这一次来的不是福神——而是灾疫——巨型未知物种直冲我们而来。

一只单个的、能够在太空中存活的生物从耀眼的星门中现身，看上去似乎在四处徘徊。由于其对我们的友好至信或警告没有任何回应，我们必须立马动员起来，将这一威胁铲除！
descriptions.en:
Once again the slumbering gateway has come alive! This time it was not a boon - but rather a bane - that came to us from the great unknown.

A single, space-dwelling creature sprang out of the glowing gateway, and seems to be on the prowl. Answering to no kind of hailing or warning, we should move to eradicate this threat immediately!

descriptions.zh:
星门被再一次激活了。这一次激活仅仅持续了不到一秒，但有东西从星门里面穿越过来。

一件来源不明的金属物体以极高的速度从传送门中射出，进入了恒星系。在任何传感器能够得到有效读数之前，这个物体就一头撞进了我们恒星系里的一颗行星。

我们应该立马针对碰撞点展开调查。
descriptions.en:
Once more the gateway has been activated. This time the activation lasted only a fraction of a second, but that was enough for something to cross over.

An unknown metallic object of extraordinary velocity shot out of the portal and cut its way through the system. Before any sensors could get a decent reading, the object had collided with a planet in our system.

We should investigate the point of impact as soon as possible.

descriptions.zh:
定位神秘探机的坠毁地点比预料中的还要困难。

根据读数，它并不是惯常意义上的坠毁了，然而这个物体接近星球表面时巨大的速度也排除了正常降落的可能。

所以到底发生了什么？是时候凑近去看一眼了。
descriptions.en:
Locating the crash site of the mysterious probe was far more complicated than anticipated.

Readings indicate that it didn't crash in a conventional sense, however the considerable velocity of the object approaching the surface also rules out a normal landing.

So what really happened? It's time to take a closer look.

options.script: name = CURIOUS

descriptions.zh:
最近的考古发现能够让我们建造一个构件，这能够稍稍打开神秘星门，并允许一艘科研船通过。

§R警告§!

这是一个高风险任务！你无法保证§Y科学官§!或§Y科研船§!能从这场致命的冒险中平安归来。谨慎准备。
descriptions.en:
Recent archaeological findings have revealed a way to build a construct that can briefly open the mysterious gateway and allow a Science Ship to pass through.

 §RWarning!§!

This is a high risk mission! There is no guarantee that either §YScientist§! or §YScience Ship§! will return from such a perilous journey. Prepare accordingly.

descriptions.zh:
组装的构件终于激活了。光矢从巨大的仪器中射出，并击中了沉睡的星门，使其开始运转。

突然间，星门特有的能量震荡中断，然后一个轻柔的、发亮的球体填充进星门。预先准备好的科研船立刻开始加速，驶入发光的领域。片刻之后，星门停止运转，只剩下回荡在太空中的宁静与肃穆。

现在我们只能等待了。
descriptions.en:
The assembled construction was finally activated. Lightning bolts shot out from the massive device and licked the slumbering gateway, making it power up.

Suddenly the gateway's distinguishing energy pulse erupted, and an ethereal, glowing orb filled the gateway. The prepared Science Ship immediately accelerated into the glowing expanse and vanished. Momentarily afterwards, the gateway instantly powered down and returned to a state of silent majesty.

Now we wait.

descriptions.zh:
没有任何预兆，我们母星系的星门突然活跃了起来——虽然时间不长，但足够让什么存在从闪耀的星门核心中显现出来。

那个金属物体没有对任何问候进行回应，也没有发射出任何信号。直到我们获得了清晰的视觉信号反馈，我们才意识到那个物体的真实本质是什么。那正是几个月之前我们送过星门的科研船。然而这艘船的年代看上去却久远多了。扫描器显示，这艘船的船龄高达一千年。

船员的遗体已作零星土尘，好在有一些未损坏的数据还能进行回收。这些数据包括了对§Y星门科技§!惊叹的描述，以及一名船员留下的一段音频资料。

“§H……那样的未来。我们一族总有一天会知道那噩梦般的一天带来的苦难——当天空下起蓝色的火焰雨的那一天。§!”
descriptions.en:
Without warning, the gateway in our home system flickered to life for a brief moment - just long enough for something to emerge from the glowing gateway core.

The metal object responded to no hails, nor emitted any signals itself. Its true nature was unknown up until the moment when we managed to get a clear visual feed. It was the Science Ship we shot into the gateway many months ago. It had aged far more than that, though. Scanners indicate the ship being more than a thousand years old.

Of the crew only dust remained, but some intact data recordings could be salvaged. The data included some marvelous descriptions of §Ygateway technology§!, as well as an audio message left by a crew member:

'§H... that future. My kind will truly know suffering on that baleful day - the day when the sky rains blue fire.§!'

descriptions.zh:
没有任何预兆，我们母星系的星门突然活跃了起来——虽然时间不长，但足够让什么存在从闪耀的星门核心中显现出来。

那个金属物体没有对任何招呼进行回应，也没有发射出任何信号。直到我们获得了清晰的视觉信号反馈，我们才意识到那个物体的真实本质是什么。那正是几个月之前我们送过星门的科研船。然而这艘船的年代看上去却久远多了。扫描器显示，这艘船的船龄高达一千年。

我们所有登舰的机械单元全部停摆，好在有一些未损坏的数据还能进行回收。这些数据包括了对§Y星门科技§!惊叹的描述，以及一枚负责这次探险的研究无人机留下的一段音频资料。

“§H……那样的未来。[Root.GetName]总有一天会知道那噩梦般的一天带来的苦难——当天空下起蓝色的火焰雨的那一天。§!”
descriptions.en:
Without warning, the gateway in our home system flickered to life for a brief moment - just long enough for something to emerge from the glowing gateway core.

The metal object responded to no hails, nor emitted any signals itself. Its true nature was unknown up until the moment when we managed to get a clear visual feed. It was the Science Ship we shot into the gateway many months ago. It had aged far more than that, though. Scanners indicate the ship being more than a thousand years old.

None of our machine units on board were functional anymore, having long since succumbed to malfunctions, but some intact data recordings could be salvaged. The data included some marvelous descriptions of §Ygateway technology§!, as well as an audio message left by the research drone in charge of the expedition:

'§H... that future. The [Root.GetName] will truly know suffering on that baleful day - the day when the sky rains blue fire.§!'

descriptions.zh:
星门又一次活了过来。在没有任何警告和准备的情况下，太空生物从发光的传送门中喷涌而出。这种生物和一段时间之前穿过星门的落单攻击者似乎是同一种类。

但是这一次数量更多了。数量远大于之前。现在已经没时间讲道理，没时间犹豫了。不是它们死，就是我们亡。军队整备！
descriptions.en:
The gateway has once more flickered to life. Without warning or hesitation space creatures spewed forth out of the glowing portal. The same type of creatures as the solitary attacker from some time ago.

This time around there are more of them. Far more. There is no room for reason here, no time for doubt. It's either them or us. To arms!

options.script: name = BATTLESTATIONS

descriptions.zh:
我们的舰队设法阻止了从星门中涌现的生物大开杀戒。当战斗就在头顶上发生时，[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的男男女女都屏着一口气。

尽管心中怀着对逝者的沉重心情，我们母星上的住民仰望天空之时依旧满怀希望。星门生物的尸体，开始下坠到行星的表面。它们的尸体在进入大气层时被点燃，在天空中留下了一道道泛着蓝晕的光之追迹。

他们已经明白了苦难，[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的人们，在这一天见到了从天而降的蓝色火焰。
descriptions.en:
Our fleet managed to thwart the onslaught of creatures that came from the gateway. Down on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] our population had held their breath as the space battle raged overhead.

Despite hearts heavy with loss, it's still with a glimmer of hope that the inhabitants of our homeworld now look up at the sky. The carcasses of the gateway creatures, falling down toward the planet's surface, leave long trails of blue-tinted streaks across the sky as their alien bodies are incinerated upon atmospheric entry.

And of suffering did they know, the inhabitants of [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName], on this day when it rained blue fire.

descriptions.zh:
我们的舰队设法阻止了从星门中涌现的生物大开杀戒。解救了[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]上许多我们的子个体。

尽管心中怀着对逝者的沉重心情，[Root.GetName]上的住民仰望天空之时依旧满怀希望。星门生物的尸体，开始下坠到行星的表面。它们的尸体在进入大气层时被点燃，在天空中留下了一道道泛着蓝晕的光之追迹。

他们已经明白了苦难，[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的子个体，在这一天见到了从天而降的蓝色火焰。
descriptions.en:
Our fleet managed to thwart the onslaught of creatures that came from the gateway, saving the lives of many of our drones down on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].

Despite our losses in the battle, the [Root.GetName] can now look to the future with a glimmer of hope. The carcasses of the gateway creatures, falling down toward the planet's surface, leave long trails of blue-tinted streaks across the sky as their alien bodies are incinerated upon atmospheric entry.

And of suffering did they know, the drones on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName], on this day when it rained blue fire.

descriptions.zh:
没有任何预兆，星门再一次被开启，这一次从星门中释放出来的时一群敌对的、神秘的太空生物。

不到几分钟，这群神秘威胁就进入[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]的轨道，并开始对星球表面投射泛着蓝色光晕的能量射线。

我们必须赶紧调集军力，立即将这股威胁抹杀，否则[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]将会被烤成一片焦墟，居住于其上的住民会因为射线灰飞烟灭。星球上的人们唯一能做的，只有寻找掩体躲避，然后眼睁睁地看着他们周围的世界被蓝色的火焰雨焚灭殆尽。
descriptions.en:
Without warning the gateway has once again opened up, this time releasing a swarm of hostile, enigmatic space creatures.

Within minutes this mysterious threat had taken position in orbit around [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] and started to bombard the surface with blue-tinted energy beams.

We need to route our forces and stop this threat immediately, before [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] becomes a smouldering ruin, and its inhabitants turned into ash. All they can do down there now is seek shelter and wait while the world around them is ravaged by the a rain of blue fire.

descriptions.zh:
没有任何预兆，星门再一次被开启，这一次从星门中释放出来的时一群敌对的、神秘的太空生物。

不到几分钟，这群神秘威胁就进入[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]的轨道，并开始对星球表面投射泛着蓝色光晕的能量射线。

descriptions.en:
Without warning the gateway has once again opened up, this time releasing a swarm of hostile, enigmatic space creatures.

Within minutes this mysterious threat had taken position in orbit around [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] and started to bombard the surface with blue-tinted energy beams.

We need to route our forces and stop this threat immediately, before [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] becomes a smouldering ruin, and our drones on the surface turned into ash. All we can do for them now is have them seek shelter and wait while the world around them is ravaged by the a rain of blue fire.

options.script: name = BATTLESTATIONS

descriptions.zh:
又一道能量激荡从星门射向了我们的母星系。和之前的能量振荡不同的是，这一次造成的后果是毁灭性的。

当电磁场扫过[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]，它使得行星上的所有电网过载，烧坏了所有的电子系统——有一些压根无从修复。

出于某些原因，星门之焰也对气候造成了改变，地表上的某几个地区在事故之后降水量于短期内骤增。主要城市大多陷入黑暗，当地居民目睹了蓝色的降水，那是渐息的能量火花照亮了天空中的雨点。
descriptions.en:
Another energy surge has flared out from the gateway in our home system. Unlike previous energy pulses, this one was devastating.

As the electromagnetic field swept over [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] it overloaded every energy grid on the planet, frying every electrical system - some beyond repair.

For some reason the gateway flare also shook the climate, as heavy rainfalls began in several places momentarily after the incident. Most major cities are now completely dark, their population caught in a rainfall colored blue as dying energy sparks light up the heavy drops in the sky.

descriptions.zh:
又一道能量激荡从星门射向了我们的母星系。和之前的能量振荡不同的是，这一次造成的后果是毁灭性的。

当电磁场扫过[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]，它使得行星上的所有电网过载，烧坏了所有的电子系统——有一些压根无从修复。

As the electromagnetic field swept over [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] it overloaded every energy grid on the planet, frying every electrical system - some beyond repair.

For some reason the gateway flare also shook the climate, as heavy rainfalls began in several places momentarily after the incident. Most major habitations are now completely dark, their units caught in a rainfall colored blue as dying energy sparks light up the heavy drops in the sky.

titles.en: The Black Crown Yields its Secrets

descriptions.zh: 我们的科学家最终成功地打开了黑王冠，让我们的船通过另一边那个相同的装置。作为这个神秘星门的最后礼物，当它激活时，一股数据流被传输到我们的系统，揭示了其构造背后的原理，使得之前神秘的东西突然变得非常清晰易懂。现在，我们的科学家相信，在短短几年内，我们也将能够建造新的通道，将我们帝国内的旅行时间减少到几乎为零。
descriptions.en: Our scientists have finally succeeded in opening the Black Crown, allowing our ships to cross to a second, identical device on the other side. As a final gift from the gateway's enigmatic builders, as it was activated, a data stream was transmitted to our systems revealing the principles behind its construction, making what had previously been mysterious suddenly seem blindingly obvious. Our scientists are now confident that, within a few short years, we too will be able to build new gateways, cutting travel times within our empire to virtually zero.

label.en: The galaxy is at our doorstep.

descriptions.zh:
我们在卫星的表面设置了一个行动基地，并派出了数个小队前往之前我们在扫描器上捕捉到的异常现象地点。

这一神秘现象的重要意义非比寻常，科学界也对于考察队可能发现什么提出了诸多理论和设想。
descriptions.en:
A base of operations has been set up on the surface of the moon, and several teams are now en route to the various anomaly sites that our scanners picked up.

The significance of this mystery is simply unparalleled, and the scientific community is absolutely buzzing with theories and anticipation over what will be uncovered by the excursion teams.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的表面设置了一个行动基地，并派出了数个小队前往之前我们在扫描器上捕捉到的异常现象地点。

这一神秘现象的重要意义非比寻常，科学界也对于考察队可能发现什么提出了诸多理论和设想。
descriptions.en:
A base of operations has been set up on the surface of [From.Planet.GetName], and several teams are now en route to the various anomaly sites that our scanners picked up.

The significance of this mystery is simply unparalleled, and the scientific community is absolutely buzzing with theories and anticipation over what will be uncovered by the excursion teams.

descriptions.zh:
大多数考察队都到达了目的地，并发回了报告。

埋在地底的文物被发掘出来。首席科学官[Leader.GetName]将它们形容为§Y十分精准的，星系级激光指向器§!——一种远古的机器，其作用是向太空发射高强度的、密实的紫外线射束，目的未知。

这真是一个喜忧参半的发现；外星文物的发现有着深远、令人振奋的重要性，然而它们的意图却看上去毫无章法。
descriptions.en:
Most excursion teams have reached their destinations and reported back.

Artifacts buried in the ground have been uncovered. Head Scientist [Leader.GetName] describes them as §Yhighly accurate, galactic laser pointers§! - ancient machines that are emitting a strong, tight ultraviolet beam out into space for purposes unknown.

It's a bittersweet discovery; the profound, exhilarating importance of alien artifacts countered by their seemingly arbitrary purpose.

descriptions.zh:
尽管我们尽了最大的努力，对在地表上的外星指示器的发掘和分析并没有带来任何有关联的结果。

考古队对外星信号射束进行了计算，并沿途一路追到头，但除了虚空什么也没有发现。

科学官[Leader.GetName]要求给予更多的时间；坚信科学团队可能错过了什么重要的东西。
descriptions.en:
Despite our best efforts the excavation and analysis of the alien indicators on the surface have failed to deliver any relevant result.

The archaeological teams have calculated and followed the paths of the alien signal beams, but nothing is being pointed at other than empty space.

Scientist [Leader.GetName] have requested more time; convinced that something has been missed by the science teams.

descriptions.zh:
突破性进展！

对地表的研究揭示了该卫星在几个纪元前曾经被一颗小行星撞击过。撞击并不足以摧毁这颗卫星，不过将其稍稍推出了原来的轨道。通过分析这次撞击，科学家们成功地推演出了这颗卫星最初的位置和自转，并用这些数据进行“倒带”，重演了外星指示器原本所指的位置。

于是乎，这个外星指示器的光束突然开始汇聚到恒星系内的另一颗行星上。
descriptions.en:
Breakthrough!

Study of the surface revealed that the moon was hit eons ago by a small asteroid. The impact was not enough to obliterate the moon but did nudge it a fraction out of its original orbit. By analyzing the impact, the scientists managed to calculate the moon's initial position and rotation, and used that data to 'rewind' the alien indicators to their original position.

And there it was: the alien indicator beams suddenly began converging on another planet in the system!

descriptions.zh:
突破性进展！

对地表的研究揭示了[From.Planet.GetName]在几个纪元前曾经被一颗小行星撞击过。撞击并不足以摧毁这颗卫星，不过将其稍稍推出了原来的轨道。通过分析这次撞击，科学家们成功地推演出了[From.Planet.GetName]最初的位置和自转，并用这些数据进行“倒带”，重演了外星指示器原本所指的位置。

于是乎，这个外星指示器的光束突然开始汇聚到恒星系内的另一颗行星上。
descriptions.en:
Breakthrough!

Study of the surface revealed that [From.Planet.GetName] was hit eons ago by a small asteroid. The impact was not enough to obliterate the planet but did nudge it a fraction out of its original orbit. By analyzing the impact, the scientists managed to calculate [From.Planet.GetName]'s initial position and rotation, and used that data to 'rewind' the alien indicators to their original position.

And there it was: the alien indicator beams suddenly began converging on another planet in the system!

descriptions.zh:
我们的考古学家已经开始了在[From.Planet.GetName]地表的工作。地震学勘测很快就在此前指示器指向的位置附近的地下发现了空洞区域。

地下的空穴非常巨大而且神秘，尽管如此有一件事情我们的专家们可以肯定：它绝非天然形成的。它一定是被人出于一定的目的建造出来的。
descriptions.en:
Our archaeological team have started their work down on [From.Planet.GetName]. Seismographic readings quickly isolated a hollow area underground on the rough location indicated by the alien indicators previously discovered.

The underground expanse is vast, and despite its mysterious nature one thing is beyond doubt amongst the experts: It's not natural. Someone built it with a specific purpose in mind.

descriptions.zh:
挖掘小队终于来到了地下结构。规模庞大，棱角分明的厅堂由隧道相连。由于几乎没看到任何装饰，要鉴别建立这个结构的目的很困难。

当[Leader.GetName]进入主室的时候，一阵低沉的声音突然回荡起来。起初这只是雷鸣般地噪声，但这声音逐渐扭变，直到变成一股空洞的人声，不断用我们的语言重复单一的句子：

§Y“你们准备好了吗？”§!

雷鸣般地人声伴随着一阵低沉的轰隆声，一座巨墙突然缓慢移开，一条黑暗的走廊显现出来。我们的考古学家迫切地想进一步深入。
descriptions.en:
The excavation crew has finally reached the underground structure. Vast, angular halls and tunnels were explored. A complete lack of adornment made it difficult to establish the purpose of the structure.

When [Leader.GetName] entered the main chamber a deep sound suddenly reverberated. Initially just thundering noise, the sound slowly contorted until an incorporeal voice spoke a single sentence in our language:

§Y'Are you ready?'§!

The booming voice was followed by deep rumble as one of the giant walls slowly slid away to reveal a dark corridor. Our archaeologists eagerly went inside.

descriptions.zh:
黑暗走廊的末端是一个空的、圆形的房室。刚一走进，那股回荡的人声再一次说话，表示§Y只有有资格之人才能继续§!。

短小的走廊从圆形房室引向了三个更小的房间——每一个房间里都包含某种物理学相关的谜题。

[Leader.GetName]相信这是一些科学谜题——只要能解开——能够引起整个结构触发特定的反应，但这全都是推测。
descriptions.en:
The dark corridor led to an empty, round chamber. Stepping inside, the disembodied voice spoke yet again, saying that §Yonly the deserving may continue§!.

Short corridors connected the round chamber to three other, small rooms - each containing some kind of physics-oriented problem.

[Leader.GetName] believes that these are scientific riddles that - once solved - may provoke some reaction in the structure, but it's all speculation.

descriptions.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]地下深处的神秘房间中的全部三个科学谜题都已被解答。

正如[Leader.GetName]先前怀疑的一样，这一结构对外星试炼的正确解答作出了反应。在最后一个谜团得到解决的同时，一个云状全息投影在主室中乍然突现。那是对我们恒星系的高分辨率描写，附有多种外星科技的滚动说明。

明亮的光点标明了星系中的另一处位置。搜索还将继续。
descriptions.en:
All three science puzzles have been completed in the mysterious chambers deep underground the surface of [From.Planet.GetName].

Just as [Leader.GetName] suspected, the structure responded to the correct solutions for the alien trials. As the last riddle was solved, a cloudy holographic projection exploded to life in the main chamber. It was a fine-resolution depiction of our solar system, along with scrolling instructions for various alien technologies.

Another galactic position was indicated by a bright point of light. The search continues.

descriptions.zh:
在一段漫长而艰难的[From.Planet.GetName]地表深挖以后，挖掘队进入了另一个底下结构中。

尽管数据表明这个结构是个洞，但是我们并没有找到可以进入的入口。它似乎被完全地封闭了，其保护墙采用了某种未知的具有难以置信的结构强度的金属——实际上我们的传统挖掘设备都没法把它划个印！

我们需要付出大量的努力来进入这里，好消息是我们将会一直努力。
descriptions.en:
After a long, arduous period of digging deep into the crust of [From.Planet.GetName] the excavation team reached another underground structure.

Despite readings indicating that the building is hollow, no entry point can be found. It appears to be hermetically sealed, and the protective walls are made of some unknown material with extreme structural integrity. Conventional digging equipment doesn't even scratch it!

It will require some serious effort to get through, but the project is already underway.

descriptions.zh:
在几个月的艰苦努力下，使用一种强大的高频高温激光，挖掘队终于撬开了这个地下建筑。

在地下室被打开后，那个无源的声音又响了起来，表达出对我们对于解决这个挑战决心的赞许，因此我们将会得到奖励。

所以就是这样。地下室埋藏着各种各样的珍宝，数不尽的财宝、某种未来可以被研究的未知科技······
descriptions.en:
After months of hard work, using a powerful beam which combines intense fusion heat with high-frequency vibration, the excavation team has finally managed to crack the underground structure.

As soon as the vault was cracked, the disembodied voice-recording spoke again. It declared that our determination had been proven, that another trial had been completed, and that we were to be rewarded accordingly.

And so we were. The bunker contained all sort of valuables, not least of which: hitherto unknown technologies which can be investigated further.

descriptions.zh:
大量的地震学读数经汇总分析形成了[From.Planet.GetName]地下结构的高度准确的视觉模型。

这似乎是一个由棱角分明的走廊连成的网络，每条走廊均达数千米长。整个结构主要由走廊构成，只有位于建筑底部的一处开放空间例外。

在我们抵达站点并对其进行适当的调查之前，无法再诠释出更多内容。
descriptions.en:
Extensive seismographic readings have been compiled into a highly accurate, visual model of the underground structure on [From.Planet.GetName].

It appears to be a vast network of angular corridors, each several kilometers long. The entire structure is mostly corridors, with the exception of one open space at the bottom of the building.

More than that cannot be interpreted until we reach and investigate the site properly.

descriptions.zh:
考古队终于在这个地下工事上打开了通道，进入了空荡荡的走廊。

走廊完全是空的。仔细检查后，能发现墙壁上刻着小且奇怪的铭文。对该外星文字的翻译结果令人困惑，后来才发现这些都是外星人的名字。为数多达百万的名字。

考古学家现在正朝着最深处的房间前进，但时不时出现的坍塌走廊段阻碍着他们的前进。
descriptions.en:
The science team finally breached the underground complex, and entered the empty corridors.

The long tunnels were completely empty. On closer inspection the walls appeared to be covered in small, strange inscriptions. Translation of the alien language was a highly confusing process, until it was discovered that the writing consisted of nothing but alien names, numbering in the millions.

Archaeologists are now pressing onwards to the bottom chamber, but their effort is hindered by caved-in corridors which need to be cleared.

descriptions.zh:
我们投放到[From.Planet.GetName]科学小队已经抵达了房间的最低处。他们在那里发现了一份古老的档案：某种个人汇报。

§Y“我们失败了，无情者撕裂了我们的整只舰队而没有丝毫拖泥带水。什么也没剩下。我们终将死在这里，死在我们纪念阵亡将士的厅堂里。

我们为那些躺在病房里的伤员而感到担心，无情者会找到他们，然后……”§!

这里没有任何打斗的迹象，没有尸体，只剩下空旷的纪念堂与死一般的寂静。
descriptions.en:
Our science team down on [From.Planet.GetName] has reached the bottom chamber of the memorial structure. There they found an ancient recorded message; some kind of personal debriefing:

§Y'We failed. The Relentless cut through our entire navy without even slowing down. All is lost now. We will die here, in these halls of tribute to fallen brethren.

We fear for the lives of our wards. The Relentless will find them, and then they...'§!

There's no sign of a struggle. No bodies. Only empty halls and the silence of the ones who perished.

descriptions.zh:
首席科学官[Leader.GetName]想要彻底的搜寻纪念堂，不放过每个角落。他是对的。在其中的一个回廊里，一个小设备被找到了。在这个设备上，我们抢救出了一段小信息碎片。

§Y“成···！它们的精神能力被关闭了，它们的聪明才智被移除了——它们不构成威胁了。

这应该够了。我们只剩下这一件事可以做。”§!

这个设备同时储存了一些新坐标。[Leader.GetName]希望尽快对这些坐标进行探查。
descriptions.en:
Head Scientist [Leader.GetName] wanted to comb through every nook and cranny of the memorial site. It paid off: a small device was discovered in one of the corridors. A small fragment of information could be salvaged from it:

§Y'...ould work! With their mental faculties shut off - their very intellect removed - they would pose no threat.

It must be enough. It's the only thing left that we can do.'§!

The device also included some new coordinates. [Leader.GetName] would like to investigate these as soon as possible.

descriptions.zh:
这次的任务用不上铲子或钻孔激光。首席科学官[Leader.GetName]和考古团队径直走进了外星人的废墟。

这处遗址非常古老——已有一千多年的历史，但保存完好。它似乎是为某一特定目的而建造的一种集散地。能看到几个实验室，还有几个规模庞大的储藏库。

考古团队发现了一个数字档案服务器。它已停止运转，但看起来很完整。希望它能填补失落的施恩者相关线索的空白之处。
descriptions.en:
There was no need for shovels or drilling lasers this time around. Head Scientist [Leader.GetName] and the archaeology team simply walked into the alien ruin.

The site is very old - more than a thousand years, but fairly well kept. It appears to be some kind of staging area, built for a specific purpose. There are several laboratories and large storage hangars.

The team have found a digital archive server. It's offline, but appears fairly intact. Hopefully it will fill in the blanks regarding our lost Benefactors.

descriptions.zh:
考古团队成功获取了外星人数字档案，并设法使其运行。该档案里包含一些内容混乱的日志，需进行进一步解读。

日志中反复出现名为§Y意识抹除方案§!的术语，它似乎是这里的研究工作的重点。施恩者显然开发了神智操纵技术，但是该技术的实现方式或开发该技术的目的仍然未知。
descriptions.en:
The science team managed to get the alien digital archives up and running. They exclusively contained arbitrary logs, which require some liberal interpretation.

The phrase '§YMind-Wipe Initiative§!' occurs frequently throughout the logs, and it appears to have been the specific focus of research at this location. Apparently the Benefactors developed the technology by which they could manipulate the effectiveness of mental faculties, but how or for what purpose remains unknown.

options.script:
name = origin.1275.a
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]上的考古团队发现了另一个古老的数字档案。该档案也包含很多流水账式的日志，但是有一条值得关注：

§Y“飞船已经起飞。我们知道他们会成功，但他们离开时没有任何希望和兴致。我们知道这个任务，以及我们在这里所做的工作，是不正当的……甚至称得上是卑劣的。

但是替代方案……替代方案更糟。”§!

这是在这个古老的设施中发现的最后一个条目之一。虽然算不上了结，但至少有了很多技术上的发现。
descriptions.en:
The archaeology team on [From.Planet.GetName] has found another ancient digital archive. This too consisted mostly of logs, but there was one journal entry of particular interest:

§Y'The ship has taken off. We know they'll succeed, but there was no sense of hope or high spirits as they left. We know that the mission and the work we've done here are wrong... Despicable.

But the alternative... The alternative is worse.'§!

That is one of the last entries found at the ancient facility. Not much of a closure, but at least plenty of technological discoveries were made.

descriptions.zh:
在清扫存储区域期间，一名工作人员发现了一个来源不明的小型设备，它被带到[Leader.GetName]面前，并被查明是一种记录设备。它已严重破损，但其中一小段对话仍可读取：

§Y“……不应被遗忘——应当有人来澄清事实，为他们发声。历史或许会容忍这一切，但我的良心不能。”§!

进一步对当初作为噪声丢弃的一串数据进行研究后。发现那原来是加密的坐标。
descriptions.en:
Clearing out the storage areas, one of the workers found a small device of unknown origin. It was brought to [Leader.GetName] and turned out to be a recording device. It was badly damaged, but a small snippet of dialog was saved:

§Y'...houldn't be forgotten - someone has to come clean and speak up for them. History may endure, but my conscience cannot.'§!

A string of data first discarded as noise was investigated further. It turned out to be encrypted coordinates.

descriptions.zh:
被派到[From.Planet.GetName]表面的团队遇到了比预期多得多的困难。

在古老的外星人研究基地中找到的坐标指向[From.Planet.GetName]的一片异常崎岖的区域，那里到处都是悬崖和裂谷。

不过，他们依然在继续前进，最终到达了指定的地点——一个自然形成的洞穴。已无需发令让他们抵近观察，洞穴探险已经开始了。
descriptions.en:
The team we sent down to the surface of [From.Planet.GetName] encountered far more obstacles than anticipated.

The coordinates we received in the ancient alien research base pointed to an exceptionally craggy part of [From.Planet.GetName], where the landscape was filled with vertical stone surfaces and deep fissures.

The team pressed on, and eventually reached the indicated location: a natural cave formation. No need to ask them to take a closer look; the spelunking is already afoot.

options.script:
name = origin.1290.a
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
考古队正在调查[From.Planet.GetName]上的自然洞穴。他们发现了一个废弃的大仓库，储存着一些有价值的原料。没有门，没有锁，也没有陷阱——单纯的一个装满了贵重工业品的洞穴。

首席科学官[Leader.GetName]希望进一步调查。这些东西摆放实在过于显眼，以至于让人怀疑这是一个骗局，即这批藏品只是用来掩饰另一个尚未发现的宝藏的幌子。
descriptions.en:
The archaeology team that was investigating the natural cave down on [From.Planet.GetName] have reported back. They found a tremendous, abandoned stockpile of valuable resources. There were no doors, no locks and no traps - just a cave full of industrial valuables.

Head Scientist [Leader.GetName] would like to investigate further still. Plentiful as it may be, the obviousness of the booty has evoked a theory that the hidden cache is merely a ruse - that another type of treasure is yet to be found.

descriptions.zh:
资源仓库确实是一个骗局——真正的宝藏被发现于一扇隐藏的门后面：一个施恩者种族的人最后录制的信息。

很久以前，他们与凶残的外星种族§S无情者§!交战。无数的文明在无情者的猎杀中被灭亡，而施恩者们也将成为下一个。绝望的施恩者想尽一切来阻止末日到来。他们成功了：一种破坏无情者的神智的设备，瞬间将整个无情者种族变成了原始人。

无情者被剥夺了理智，变得服从无害。施恩者将他们集中捕获，放逐到我们的家乡。

无情者是我们的祖先。
descriptions.en:
The resource cache was indeed a deception. The real treasure lay behind a hidden door: a final message, recorded by one of the Benefactor aliens.

Eons ago they were at war with a merciless alien race known as §SThe Relentless§!. Entire civilizations had already perished in the Relentless' wake, and the Benefactors were next. The desperate Benefactors sought their last resort, before all would be lost. They succeeded with a device that ravaged The Relentless' neurological physique, instantaneously primitivizing an entire race.

Robbed of their bloodthirsty intellect, The Relentless became docile and harmless. The Benefactors rounded them up and exiled them to our home world.

The Relentless are our ancestors.

label.zh: 这故事的高潮，真不知是何滋味。

options.script:
name = origin.1300.a
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
资源仓库是一个骗局。最终我们在山洞中发现了一个隐藏的录音设备：

§Y“很久以前，我的种族——当时被称作§S无情者§!，在整个星系中掀起战乱，任何挡在我们面前的感性外星人都会被我们的舰队无情地碾碎。

最终我们脱离了作为战争贩子的生存之道。我们看着残酷的历史，不再感到骄傲，只感到羞耻和悲哀。

我们追寻祖先的赎……”§!

其余的内容乱七八糟。科学官[Leader.GetName]确信可以恢复失真内容，但这需要时间。
descriptions.en:
The resource cache was a deception. A hidden recording device was eventually found within the cave:

§Y'Eons ago, my species - known at the time as §SThe Relentless§! - laid waste to the galaxy. Any sentient alien that crossed our path was engaged by our fleets without hesitation or mercy.

Eventually we evolved beyond our warmonger ways. We looked at our savage history and no longer felt pride - only shame and regret.

Retracing our ancestor's ste...'§!

The rest is scrambled. Scientist [Leader.GetName] is convinced that distortion can be restored, but it will take some time.

options.script:
name = origin.1305.a
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
[Leader.GetName]已成功修复了外星人录音中损坏的部分：

§Y“我们追寻祖先的赎罪步伐，来到了这个星系。我们的祖先在这里灭亡了特瓦'菲亚种族。那时我们不知道特瓦'菲亚通过使[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]变成对我们无害的原始人，将[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]从我们眼皮底下掩藏起来。

这种效果是不可逆的。[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]仍然只是原始人。现在，我们希望有一天他们能够重返太空，并希望他们找到我们留下的赎罪标记。”§!

就这样，我们的历史得到了解释。现在，让我们关注未来。
descriptions.en:
[Leader.GetName] has successfully restored the scrambled alien recording:

'§YRetracing our ancestor's steps on a quest for redemption, we reached this system. Here our predecessors annihilated the Thwaa'Phyr race. We didn't know then that the Thwaa'Phyr had concealed another species - the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] - by using a procedure which suppressed the intellectual capacity of the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], rendering them harmless to us.

This effect is irreversible. The [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] are still mere savages. Now we hope that one day they'll find their way back to the stars, and that they find our tokens of atonement.'§!

And there it is: our history explained. Now let's focus on the future.

label.zh: 接受这一切，并迈步向前。

descriptions.zh:
在一堵假石洞墙后面，考古团队发现了一系列数据片段。它们揭示了这样一个故事：

很久以前，两个主要阵营之间发生了主权的争夺战，施恩者一方陷入了僵局。为了取得优势，一方发起了一场假旗行动，冒充另一方攻击了一个弱小的种族——也就是我们的祖先。

名为“突触阻尼炸弹”的装置在我们曾经的母星上爆炸。它未对环境产生破坏，但其脉冲影响了我们祖先的大脑，使他们退化了。

留给我们的赠礼表明，施恩者最终寻求赎罪。
descriptions.en:
The archaeology team found a collection of data snippets behind a fake cave wall. As we scrutinized them, a theme began to emerge.

Eons ago the Benefactors were locked in stalemate as two major factions wrestled for sovereignty. In an effort to gain advantage, one side executed a false flag operation: posing as their own opposition, they attacked a lesser species - our ancestors.

A 'synaptic dampener bomb' was triggered on our home planet. It did nothing to the ecology, but the pulse affected our ancestor's brains, causing them to regress.

The tokens left behind for us indicate that the Benefactors eventually sought redemption.

label.zh: 我们不要被利用了！睁大眼睛看清楚！
label.en: We are not pawns! Just watch!

options.script:
name = origin.1315.a
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
挖掘队在一堵假墙后面发现了一个记录装置，里面是一位施恩者的自白。

很久以前，施恩者通过技术手段使我们的物种“失了智”，以躲避某种迫在眉睫的星系级威胁。尽管这可能出于好心，但威胁过去后，施恩者并未恢复我们祖先的神智，他们抛弃了我们。

在这里发现的设备和技术是一个独立团体留下的恩惠，这个团体同情我们那已陷于蒙昧的前辈。
descriptions.en:
Hidden behind a fake wall, the excavation team found a single recording device containing the confessions of one of the Benefactors.

Eons ago, the Benefactors 'dumbed down' our species by technological intervention, in order to hide us from some kind of impending galactic threat. Benevolent as that may have seemed, once the threat had passed the Benefactors spent no effort in trying to restore our ancestors' faculties - they simply abandoned us.

The sites and technology discovered in our home system are boons, left by an independent group which took pity on our diminished predecessors.

label.zh: 看看我们！我们不需要施舍。
label.en: Witness us! We don't need any charity.

options.script:
name = origin.1320.a
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
在假墙的后面，发掘队发现了一个录音设备，其中包含神秘的施恩者留下的消息。

他们正在与一些恶毒、令人作呕的外星人种族进行一场绝望的战争。为了使我们远离敌人的进攻，他们使用技术破坏了我们祖先的思维能力，希望敌人不要理会一个孤立的星球上的[Owner.GetPreFTLLower]物种。

这对我们是有用的，但最终施恩者们的命运却走到了尽头。他们给我们留下了这些隐藏的资源库存和技术，希望有一天我们能找到它们。
descriptions.en:
Secreted behind a fake wall, the excavation team found a single recording device containing a message left by the mysterious Benefactors.

They were fighting a desperate war against an unnamed, malevolent and warmongering alien race. In an effort to hide us from the enemy's advance they used technology to suppress the intellectual capacity of our ancestors, hoping that the enemy would bear no heed to the [Owner.GetPreFTLLower] species of a single, isolated planet.

It worked for us, but the fate of the Benefactors was forfeit. They left us these hidden caches of resources and technology, hoping that one day we'd find them.

descriptions.zh:
最终，我们真实历史中遗失的片段解释清楚了我们历史记载中的冲突之处。我们一直以为，我们文明的进步靠的是我们自己，孤独和独立。现在我们知道了，我们一直§L站在巨人的肩膀上§!。

我们无法改变过去。我们应当释然并继续前进——接受过去不是沉重的负担，而是迈向未来之路的垫脚石。

§Y是我们成为巨人的时候了。§!
descriptions.en:
Finally, the inconsistencies in our history have been explained, using these lost chapters from our true heritage. We had once believed that the advancement of our civilization came of our own accord - solitary and independent. Now we know that in all this time, we had been standing §Lon the shoulders of giants§!.

We cannot change the past. We reconcile and we move on - accepting our past not as a dark burden, but as a stepping stone on our path forward into the future.

§YIt is our time to become giants.§!

descriptions.zh: 所有的人力物力都被集中到了[From.Planet.GetName]的表面。下一步就是将其埋入足够深的地下，使得它能够经受得住时间和气候的考验。
descriptions.en: All the materiel and manpower has been sent down to the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. Next step is to bury it deep enough that it will stand the tests of both time and weather.

options.script:
name = origin.1365.a
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的地表之下深埋了大量的资源和科技蓝图。我们也设下了一个信标，希望假以时日特瓦'菲亚能够发现它。
descriptions.en: A generous cache of resources and technology blueprints has been buried deep beneath the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. A beacon was placed as well, and in time we can only hope that the Thwaa'Phyr will find it.

label.zh: 希望他们能够找到自己的生存之道。

descriptions.zh:
在例行的星系扫描中，我们的一个传感器接收到了一条微弱且奇特的能量信号。很有可能是聚变引擎或类似设备留下的痕迹，但其特征与我们迄今为止遇到的任何东西都不匹配，而且它似乎太过古旧-信号已发出几千年了！我们的科学家中有人提出了一种理论，认为该聚变引擎的痕迹是“施恩者”留下的。

我们应该尽快将我们的深空探测部门的工作重心转移到该研究项目上。
descriptions.en:
During a routine system scan one of our sensors picked up a small - but strange - energy signature. It's quite likely trace exhaust from a fusion drive or something similar, but the signature doesn't match anything we've encountered so far, and it appears to be remarkably old - several thousands of years! One theory amongst our scientists is that the fusion drive trail might belong to the Benefactors.

We should assign our astro-science department to this research project as soon as we can.

descriptions.zh:
这条由聚变引擎留下的古老痕迹由于年代过于久远而难以分析。最终科学机构终于设法计算出了一条可能的航行轨迹，轨迹通向一个不过几跳之内但迄今为止无人发现的未知恒星系。

目标星系确认开放，我们应该考虑派出一艘科研船来做进一步的调查。
descriptions.en:
The old fusion drive trail turned out be quite challenging to analyze due to its considerable age. Eventually the science department managed to calculate a likely navigation vector, and establish that the trail was pointing to a hitherto unknown system not many jumps away.

The destination has been made available, and we should consider sending a science vessel there to investigate further.

descriptions.zh:
在传感器对[From.solar_system.GetName]进行了第一次全面扫描之后，显而易见的是很久以前在这片恒星系中发生过大规模极具破坏性的暴力冲突。

损坏的舰船碎片与残骸散布在恒星系的四处，虚空中充满着由激光武器与聚变炸弹产生的残留能量.

在这片寂静的墓地中一个单一的信号被分离了出来，它来自附近的一个小型空间站。
descriptions.en:
Even after the first, broad sensor reading of the [From.solar_system.GetName] system it became clear that something very violent and destructive occurred here eons ago.

Broken spaceship parts and debris are scattered throughout the system, and the local void is teeming with energy residue from weaponized lasers and fusion explosions.

In this silent graveyard a single signal has been isolated, and it's coming from a small space station nearby.

descriptions.zh:
被截获的信号来源于空间站上的某个紧急弹射舱。由于毁坏极为严重，这座损毁的空间站没有留下太多能告诉我们这里发生过什么的线索。我们的科学家设法将数据片段整合到一起以拼凑出事件经过。

这座空间站就是发明意识抹除科技（就是那个让我们祖先变得愚笨的科技）的科研设施。这座空间及其防御舰队被某支未知力量所控制，而这项科技也大概率被其盗取。

有一段尤为有趣的文本被翻译完毕，那是来自敌军舰队的无线电对话。

§Y“他们正试图逃跑！跟上他们，用他们自己的武器攻击他们，看看他们会怎么享受这些炮火”§!

我们检测到了一道新的聚变引擎航迹，并基于航迹确定了一条离开的航道。
descriptions.en:
The signal we picked up originated from an emergency pod aboard the space station. Due to severe damage, the dead station left few clues to what happened here. Our scientists have managed to piece together snippets of data, in order to form a narrative.

This station was a research facility, and is where the Mind-Wipe technology was invented - the same technology used to diminish our ancestors. The station and its protective fleet were engaged by some unknown force, after which the technology was most likely stolen.

One particularly interesting message has been translated - radio chatter from the enemy fleet:

§Y'They're trying to escape! Follow them. Use their own weapon against them. See how they like it.'§!

We've picked up a new fusion drive trail and established an exit vector based on it.

descriptions.zh: 在这个未经探索的星系中，施恩者的航迹消失了。我们的远程传感器没有发现任何异常，但我们应该对星系进行适当的调查，看看我们能找到什么。
descriptions.en: The trail of the Benefactors ends in this unexplored system. Our long range sensor doesn't pick up anything unusual, but we should survey the system properly to see what we can find.

descriptions.zh:
在这个恒星系中发现的[GetPreFTLLower]物种不是别的，正是§Y特瓦'菲亚§!——在我们的文化中，更常用的称呼是§L施恩者§!。

我们的异种学家对细节还不确定，但一切都表明，不知何故，他们成了自己的神智抹除技术的牺牲品，被留在这个星球上自生自灭。没有人比我们更清楚这种命运的含义。

我们应该仔细考虑接下来的行动。
descriptions.en:
The [GetPreFTLLower] species found in this system is none other than the §YThwaa'Phyr§! - known more commonly in our culture as the §LBenefactors§!.

Our xenologists are unsure of the details, but everything indicates that they somehow fell victim to their own mind-wiping technology, and were left on this planet to fend for themselves. No one knows the implications of this fate better than we do.

We should consider our next step carefully.

descriptions.zh:
有时宇宙中的事件会以最诗意的方式展开。我们祖先曾经无可争议的主人，特瓦'菲亚，最终与我们的祖先遭受了同样的命运。

无论他们的本意如何，我们都必须承认，他们在某种程度上试图挽回他们绝望和过激的行为。

世世代代过去了，双方地位颠倒了过来，我们还了他们的恩惠。

就像[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]物种曾经经历过的那样，现在是时候让特瓦'菲亚体验站在巨人肩膀上的感受了。
descriptions.en:
Sometimes the events of the universe unfold in a most poetic fashion. Once the undisputable masters of our ancestors, the Thwaa'Phyr species eventually found themselves struck by the same fate as our ancestors.

Whatever their intention might have been, we must acknowledge the fact that to some degree, they tried to redeem their desperate and excessive act.

Now that eons have passed, the sides have been reversed, and we have returned their favor.

Just as the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] species once did, now it's time for the Thwaa'Phyr to experience what it means to stand on the shoulders of giants.

descriptions.zh:
我们的传感器在母星系捕捉到了一股奇怪的能量信号。这股信号十分强大，一开始人们还以为是仪器出了问题，但进一步的检查表明这个读数是由一个聚变推进器在久远之前造成的能量轨迹。

为了了解更多情况我们需要更深层次的分析，但是有可能这道追迹是无情者千年之前离开我们星系的时候留下的。

我们应该进一步调查。
descriptions.en:
One of our sensors recently picked up a strange energy signature in our home system. It was almost dismissed as a glitch at first; upon closer inspection the reading turned out to be an ancient energy trail from a fusion-based propulsion drive.

Deeper analysis is needed to know more, but it is possible that this trail was left by the Relentless when they left our system thousands of years ago.

We should investigate this further.

descriptions.zh:
尽管年代久远，我们的科学部门还是设法分析了引擎追迹，并得到了它的退出矢量。这意味着我们可以追踪那个我们在上古年代遇到的那个恶魔了。

时间能否完全抹平他们狂躁的天性，抑或是我们发现了一个新的威胁？新的航线已经绘制完毕，只要我们愿意，随时可以开始追踪。
descriptions.en:
Despite its remarkable age, our science department have managed to analyze the drive trail sufficient to ascertain its exit vector. This effectively means that we can pursue the demons of our past.

Has enough time passed to quell their violent nature completely, or are we to discover a new threat? A new route has been plotted, and we can pursue it whenever we want.

descriptions.zh:
一进入恒星系，我们的探测器就发现了许多异常现象。

最明显的信号是一个硕大无比的能量云，靠近一看则会发现它是有数百条与之前所发现相类似的更小的聚变推进航迹组成的。必然有一支很庞大的舰队处于某种原因在此处逗留过。

在这个“舰队停泊处”边上，我们的探测器发现了另一种信号。那是一艘被遗弃的运输船。这艘飞船应该与边上的能量信号一样古老，不过它所带的航迹信号与航迹团并不相同。

我们应该靠近一些观察这艘废弃的舰船。
descriptions.en:
On entering the system, our sensors immediately picked up multiple anomalies.

The most prominent reading was a gigantic energy cloud which - upon closer inspection - turned out to be hundreds of smaller fusion drive trails like the one previously discovered. An absolutely massive fleet must've come to a halt here for some reason.

Next to this 'fleet parking lot' our scans picked up another kind of reading: a derelict transport ship. This freighter appears to be as old as the energy signatures, but traces of its own signature differs from that of the lost fleet.

We should inspect the abandoned ship closer.

descriptions.zh:
这艘运输船里有一份日志。虽然因时间流逝而老化，但仍可以恢复出不少数据。

这艘运输船被那支巨大的舰队拦截。由于尚不明确的原因及方式，这艘运输船的船长最终与无情舰队的指挥官进行了谈话。他们的谈话似乎持续了数周，虽然不知道他们具体谈了什么，但是“力量的本质”这个说法被反复地提到。

那支舰队突然离去，而留下的那艘运输船则安然无恙。日志的最后一行援引自指挥官：§Y“算了，放了他们吧。毁灭是很容易的事情，真正的力量是创造的能力。”§!

我们已经分析了舰队的航迹，并可以重新起程追赶我们的目标。
descriptions.en:
The freighter contained a log. Though damaged by time, some data could still be recovered.

The freighter had been intercepted by the massive fleet. Unclear as to how or why, the Captain of the freighter ended up conversing with the Commander of the Relentless fleet. Apparently they spoke for weeks, but what they spoke of remains unknown - although the phrase 'nature of power' recurs frequently.

The fleet suddenly departed, leaving the freighter unscathed. The last entry in the log was a quote from the Commander: §Y'No, leave them. Destruction is easy. Real power is the ability to create.'§!

We have analyzed the fleet trails and may take up our pursuit again.

descriptions.zh:
这里就是聚变引擎航迹的终点。如果有任何可能存在的无情舰队的遗留物应该能在这里找到。

目前为止探测器所发现的信号中唯一一个值得关注的似乎是源自某种小型的太空站。它以一定的间隔向外辐射着能量脉冲，然而除此之外它似乎没有任何其他的活动迹象。

我们可以立刻对其展开调查。
descriptions.en:
This is where the fusion drive trail ends. It's quite likely that any remnants of the Relentless species - if there are any - will be found here.

So far the only sensor reading of any particular interest comes from what appears to be some kind of small space station. An energy pulse radiates from it at set intervals, but apart from that there's no sign of any activity.

We can proceed to investigate immediately.

descriptions.zh:
科学家们对古旧空间站的调查已经结束。这整个结构是个某种类型的大炮。很久以前，这门大炮开火了，向无情者的母星发射了一股脉冲。那股脉冲我们——[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]一族——十分清楚作用是什么：§Y心智抹除脉冲§!。

为了补偿他们曾经犯下的罪愆，无情者——现在名为§Y温姆托沙§!——对自己使用了这门武器，让他们的整个文明在心智上退回到了土著时代。

这一决定的规模——还有造成的后果——清楚地说明了无情者对于赎罪是多么的严肃。我们能够原谅他们吗？
descriptions.en:
The scientists have finished their investigation of the old space station. The entire structure is a big cannon of sorts. Eons ago it triggered and fired a pulse at the Relentless homeworld - a pulse that we, the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName], know full well: a §YMind-Wipe pulse§!.

In a quest to redeem themselves from their past sins, the Relentless - now known as the §YVemetosha§! - used the weapon on themselves, effectively diminishing their entire civilization.

The magnitude of such a decision - and the follow-through - stands as testament to how very seriously the Relentless wanted to atone. Can we forgive them?

options.script: name = origin.1405.a

descriptions.zh: 宇宙历史中黑暗的一章已经翻过，崭新而光明的篇章则由我们来谱写完成。我们的德政工程仿佛在我们的社会中投下了一颗石子，每一个人的心中都激起了使命感和道德感的涟漪。尽管漆黑的深空仍然深不可测，但也许这个宇宙并非完全是那么地漆黑冰冷。
descriptions.en: A dark chapter of in the history of the universe has ended, and we have written a new one - a brighter chapter. Our benevolent project initiated a ripple effect in our society, each member feeling a sense of purpose and good intent. Maybe space isn't such a dark place after all - the unfathomably vast darkness of the void notwithstanding.

descriptions.zh: 将资源和工业装备运送到[From.Planet.GetName]的庞大任务已经结束。接下来就是向地底深处挖掘，建造一个坚固的，能够经历上千年地址变动和岁月风霜侵蚀的构造。
descriptions.en: The massive undertaking to transport resources and industrial equipment to [From.Planet.GetName] has been completed. Next step is to dig deep into the ground and build a structure strong enough to withstand eons of crude weather and tectonic shifts.

options.script:
name = DIG
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh: 一个装着资源和科技蓝图的巨大宝箱被埋藏在了[From.Planet.GetName]的表面之下。我们不清楚温姆托沙的子孙们能不能、会在什么时候以及如何发现我们的宝藏，不过我们可以寄与最大的希望。谁知道呢？或许千年之后他们会发现我们太空船的推进航迹，并找到我们。
descriptions.en: A tremendous cache of resources and technology blueprints has been buried beneath the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. We have no idea if, when or how our treasure will be discovered by the Vemetosha descendants, but we can hope for the best. Who knows? Maybe in a thousand years they will find our space ship propulsion trails and come visit us.
